title: queue ticket
description: One change waiting its turn in the queue of a served thing, a file in <served folder>/<app folder>/.queue/ (ADR-S14). A ticket, never a command: each process runs its own change. Two app versions share the queue at once: apiVersion, kind and metadata never change; spec may grow. How every app shares the folder is fixed for v1 in the README, section The change queue on disk.

id.description: The ticket's place in the line and its file name without .json: 20 digits, so their order as strings is their order as numbers, and a lower id goes first.

app.description: The product ID of the app that waits.

pid.description: The process that waits, on host.

host.description: The machine the process runs on, as it names itself.

change.description: What the change does, for people reading the queue.

spec.description: Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older reader accepts them (CT-RULE-4).
